List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the March 21, 2002 / Phalguna 30, 1923 (Saka)

Total number of questions—20
WIN2\SESSION\5619RS 79
Dr. M.S. Swaminathan's
recommendations on agricultural
sector
*261. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that agricultural
scientist, Dr. M.S. Swaminathan has come
out with a report containing far reaching
recommendations for achieving high growth
in agriculture and making the farm produce
competitive;
(b) whether the recommended
agricultural reforms envisage massive
investment in the agricultural sector by both
the public and private sectors; and
(c) if so,  the details of these
recommendations and Government's policy
thereon?
Prime Minister's Japan visit
*262. SHRI RUMANDLA RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL  AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Prime Minister's visit to
Japan has been successful;
(b) if so, whether Japan has agreed to
provide aid that was stopped due to the
Pokhran test;
(c) to what extent Japanese investment
in India would increase; and
(d) if so, to what extent these agreements
would help?
Amendment to Industrial Disputes
Act, 1947
*263. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of LABOUR
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-report captioned
"Central labours to make lay-offs easy"
which appeared in the 'Newstime' dated the
23rd February, 2002; and
(b) the safeguards taken/proposed to be
taken to protect interests of labour before
amending the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947
to lay off employees without Government's
permission?

80

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Ban on duplicate brands of goods
†*264. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
'SURYA': Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the companies making
consumer goods are demanding for a special
ban to check the duplicate brands of the
goods;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether the present laws are not
effective; and
(d) the steps Government propose to take
in the matter?
Council for Clean India
*265. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Vigilance Commission has formed a Council
for Clean India (CFCI);
(b) if so, what is its composition and
objectives;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the Central
Vigilance Commission (CVC) is coming
up with a new measurable index for
Government organisations called as
"Corruption Permission Index"; and
(d) if so, the definition of the Index?
Use of IT in SSI sector
*266. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of SMALL SCALE
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Small Scale
Industry is much backward so far as
application of Information Technology is
concerned;
(b) whether the SSI is lacking in
productivity, cost control and
competitiveness in the absence of
Information Technology;
(c) if so, whether Government propose
to give incentives to the SSI with a view to
help them in inducting Information
Technology; and
(d) if so, the details of the steps taken/
being taken by Government in this
regard?
Uniform sugarcane price
*267. SHRI NARENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD  AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for not having uniform
sugarcane price all over the country as
sugarcane itself is a major cost input in
manufacturing sugar; and
(b) if not, the administrative difficulties
in doing so?
FBI Director's Delhi visit
*268. DR. KARAN SINGH: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether following the Home
Minister's US visit, the Director
Investigation of the Federal Bureau of
Investigations of the US, Mr. Robert
Mueller visited New Delhi;
(b) if so, the purpose of the visit and the
outcome thereof; and
(c) the nature and extent of cooperation
to fight terrorism expected to be extended
by the FBI?

81

Karnataka has requested to allocate 6000

Utilisation of financial assistance for
SSI
1903. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the share of very small industries;
cottage industries and Small Scale Industries
in the total industrial production of the
country;
(b) whether any financial assistance is
given by the Central Government to these
industries, if so, the details thereof
particularly in Rajasthan/Orissa;
(c) whether Government have sought
the progress report regarding utilisation of
funds, district-wise in these States; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
KVIC projects in Gujarat
1904. SHRI AHMED PATEL: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether KVIC has taken up projects
or industries in Gujarat under the Rural
Employment Generation Programme;
(b) if so, the details thereof for the last
three years, year-wise and district-wise; and
(c) what is the present status thereof?
Potentiality of agro-based rural
industries in NE States
1905. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have studied
potentiality of the agro-based rural industries
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether there is any plan to bring the
potentiality into reality?
Bhabha Atomic Research Centre
1906. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the number of scientists working in
Bhabha Atomic Research Centre at Mumbai;
(b) the annual expenditure of this
institute;
(c) the objective of this organization; and

Programme for entrepreneurs
1910. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-

state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
rupees 100 crore programme for
entrepreneurs and small and medium

Action plan to redress public
grievances of telephone consumers

RAO: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are executing
any action plan to redress public grievances
of telephone consumers and early clearance
of faults in the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?

Russian co-operation for Kudankulam
Plant
1907. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH:
PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Russia and
India have signed a contract for delivery of
major equipments for construction of the
Kudankulam Nuclear Plant in Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
the construction would be completed; and
(c) the details of further developmental
programmes for the Plant?
Nuclear power plant at Kudankulam
1908. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to set up $3 billion nuclear
power plant at Kudankulam in Tamil Nadu;
(b) whether some activists are protesting
against this project claiming that the nuclear
waste from this plant would affect health of
the people of the surrounding area; and
(c) if so, what action Government have
taken in this regard?
Uranium reserves in Chhattisgarh
